d: In the middle of the scene Zamoro is standing surrounded by a dragon of Aitian Warriors. On one side Jarico sits on a rock. Here and there, from both sides, are scattered in groups the Maima Wilds in action to deliberate over things heard.
Jarico, and Zamoro.
Hunters and Hunters, go to Zilia.
Jarico, Zamoro, and Zilia.

The interior of the camp of Colombo on the shores of the sea. The Castilian ships that were shipwrecked, stranded on the beach, and on them raised the fortifications. Castilians are all on the ships, facing the sea, trying to discover some sails, in the distant horizon. Colombo exits.
Colombo, and Diego.

The trumpets of the field sound, all Castilians gradually come out. Indian women advance to the sound of barbaric instruments, bearing fruits, game, etc.The Castilians join them, and change gifts of mirrors, bells, and colorful glass grains.
Fernando, go to Zilia.

Wide forest near the camp of Columbus. On the sides of the deep caves. The sun is at sunset. Jaric, alone, in the choir of Indians of both sexes. Out of the caves come the Warriors armed with spades, and the Women of Faces.
Zamoro, with Indian Warriors, and sayings.
Odesi at the sound of drums. Castigliani, led by Colombo, Fernando and Diego, come out.
Zilia, and sayings.
The decoration represents the interior of the captain of Colombo. Colombo.
Columbus, Diego, and Castilian officers.
Colombo.
Zamoro, and Colombo. Castilian soldiers, who take sides on one side, Indian Warriors, who form a group on the other.
Inside the houses of the Wilds, where they guard their prisoners. Fernando.
Fernando, Jarico, Zamoro, and Indian officers.
Zilia, Cori, and sayings.
Jarico, and Zamoro.
Zamoro, go to Zilia.
choir of Indian warriors, and sayings.

The sacred enclosure that puts to the underground dedicated to the gods of Maima, whose opening was seen in the middle. The place is open in the bottom, and from far I discovered the sea. It is night. The sky is serene and starry, and gradually the moon rises.
Zilia in the midst of the Custodians, Jarico with Warriors.
Zilia.
The fortune tellers and the Vegliardi reappear from the basement. Jaric returns, with Zamoro, and follow the Indians.
Colombo, Fernando, Castigliani and sayings.
Diego arrives hasty from the beach. Fiesco boat with numerous Castigliani bed, to the sound of military gang, and to the noise of artillery.
To satisfy the actress who represents Zilia's character, the following verses are substituted for the recitation of the scene XIV of Act II.
